header: Paul Merson Concerns Over Arsenal's Viktor Gyokeres

header: Chelsea's Late Equaliser Stuns Manchester City
content: Chelsea's Enzo Fernandez scored a crucial injury-time equalizer to secure a 1-1 draw against Manchester City at the Etihad Stadium. header: Tottenham Held by Sunderland as Pressure Mounts on Thomas Frank
content: Tottenham Hotspur's struggles continued with a 1-1 draw against Sunderland, increasing pressure on head coach Thomas Frank.
